mathematics.assertion_tested: The proposed mean-zero scalar Green kernel on S3 satisfies its radial differential equation, singular/antipodal behavior and local curvature expansion; its constant 1/R contribution cancels between self and pair terms in the listed neutral charge configurations.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Sympy exact symbolic trigonometric algebra and rational coefficients; mpmath real arbitrary precision
mathematics.conventions: -Delta G=delta-1/V; V=2pi²R³; same flat singular-core subtraction in self and pair entries; R large at fixed geodesic separation
inputs: six neutral configurations with k positive and k negative unit charges, k=1,...,6
mean integral at 60 and 85 decimal digits
non_claims: No uniform estimate for pair separations proportional to R
No physical QCD or electromagnetic alpha result
